disposition_mapping.rationale: Document assembly carries no judgment and disappears as a distinct human-paced step, but the council converged (finance_domain, agentic_architect, accounting_standards, emerging_economy) that this is not inert plumbing: the merged function must pin and persist the specific document versions read at match time, not re-query current ERP state later, because this is what establishes the IAS 2 cost basis (KB-09) and preserves the evidential trail (KB-02). It must also expose an explicit 'incomplete data' terminal state, distinct from an exception, for environments with asynchronous or partially digitized GRN/PO feeds.

Quantity matching is deterministic arithmetic; no accountable judgment was exercised in the baseline either. It is folded into the single automated computation pass, satisfying R-01, but retained as an individually identifiable output (R-03) and extended with partial-receipt aggregation logic so real multi-delivery populations do not generate false exceptions, per finance_domain and agentic_architect's state-model requirement.

Price and terms matching is likewise deterministic rules logic and merges into the same automated pass (R-02), retaining purchase order data as a consumed input (R-04) and remaining an individually identifiable output per KB-09's cost-evidence basis. The council's convergent addition of a provisional-price/final-price and FX/tax-jurisdiction distinction is incorporated as a build requirement, not an operational nicety, since miscategorising it misstates cost under IAS 2, not merely floods the exception queue.

Tolerance evaluation is a mechanical threshold comparison and merges into the automated pass (R-05), continuing to consume the tolerance policy (R-06). The council unanimously required the policy itself to remain a separately versioned, independently change-logged artifact outside engine code, grounded in KB-06 policy-consistency: a tolerance change alters how matched cost is effectively computed and must be surfaced, not smuggled into a routine deploy.

The council decisively rejected day-one autonomous resolution of exceptions (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, accounting_standards, and ultimately the maximalist all converged here) on KB-04/KB-05 grounds: an exception disposition is an estimation-adjacent commercial judgment requiring an accountable human with a documented, inspectable basis, not a pattern-matched auto-close. The function is restructured, not merely retained unchanged: an agent performs read-only investigation autonomously (a genuine efficiency gain, including for intermittent-connectivity sites), but produces a proposal object only; a human analyst must see the underlying evidence and reasoning, not a conclusion, before disposition. A path to narrow, validated autonomy is specified with a named gate (two-quarter monitored parallel run, bounded population, permanent residual sample, kill switch) rather than left as an open-ended aspiration. The displaced investigation task content is named explicitly as a workforce-redeployment event into confirmation, sampling-review and attestation functions, per emerging_economy's non-negotiable, rather than left as an unstated decision.

Clean and in-tolerance matches auto-release with no human touch (R-07 satisfied via the exception/override gate, not uniform review), because KB-04's accountable-human requirement attaches to estimation, which a clean mechanical match lacks. But the council (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, accounting_standards) rejected the maximalist's zero-review design for the auto-released population: a risk-weighted sample with real escalation authority back into the policy/engine is required so KB-02's evidential-trail standard binds at the population level, not just the individual-transaction level. Ordering (R-08: exception resolution before release) and actor separation (R-09: AP analyst vs AP supervisor) are both preserved by construction.

Unconstrained by design, but the council unanimously rejected 'continuous logging with no review' as sufficient (hitl_designer, accounting_standards, pragmatist, emerging_economy): a log nobody opens is functionally indistinguishable from no evidential trail under KB-02. The periodic manual compilation activity is eliminated and absorbed as immutable, queryable event logging generated continuously inside TGT-01 and TGT-03, but a genuinely reviewed, itself-logged monthly attestation is retained as a distinct step (TGT-04) with a defined minimum review scope and an exportable, lightweight-access path for connectivity- or licence-constrained environments, so the control is restructured rather than hollowed into an unexamined artifact.

steps.actor: Matching engine (deterministic rules/code core with a bounded, confidence-scored classification component; no agentic judgment in the arithmetic itself)
steps.description: A deterministic rules engine retrieves invoice, PO and GRN records through versioned read-tools and persists the exact document instances read (not a live re-query) as an immutable, replayable snapshot before computing anything, directly satisfying the invoice-GRN-PO evidence chain that IAS 2 (KB-09) and the evidential-trail principle (KB-02) require. Within the same automated pass it computes quantity variance (with explicit partial-receipt aggregation logic producing a distinct 'awaiting further receipt' state, not a false exception), computes price/terms variance (with explicit provisional-price-vs-final-price and discount/rebate buckets, and first-class FX/multi-jurisdiction tax handling per KB-07/KB-08, so cost 'net of settlement discounts and rebates' is not misstated), and evaluates both against a tolerance policy that is a separately versioned, independently change-logged artifact read (and logged) at evaluation time, consistent with KB-06 policy-consistency. A bounded, confidence-scored classifier sorts each case into 'closed, no judgment required' versus 'judgment required,' defaulting to human routing on low confidence. A distinct, non-exception 'incomplete data' terminal state exists for cases where GRN or PO data has not yet synchronised, with its own re-evaluation trigger on data arrival and a staleness escalation if it persists, so infrastructure latency is never counted as a control exception or silently corrupts match-rate reporting. Quantity variance detail and price/terms variance detail remain individually identifiable outputs even though the step boundary is collapsed.
steps.name: Automated match computation, classification and evidence capture
outputs: Quantity variance detail (including partial-receipt and awaiting-further-receipt states)
Price and terms variance detail (including provisional-vs-final and FX/tax buckets)

steps.actor: Investigation agent (read-only autonomy) with AP analyst as accountable confirming human
steps.description: For cases classified as exceptions or flagged judgment-required, an investigation agent runs read-only tool calls (vendor correspondence retrieval, historical invoice/pattern lookup, GRN/PO history) fully autonomously, including asynchronously at connectivity-light sites, and produces a proposal object: a draft disposition (accept, correct, reject) with cited evidence and a stated rationale and confidence. No system state changes and no vendor-facing communication is sent on this basis alone. An accountable AP analyst must view the underlying variance detail, correspondence and the agent's reasoning chain itself -- not a pre-digested recommendation -- and must affirmatively confirm or override the disposition before it is marked resolved, satisfying KB-04's requirement that an estimation-adjacent judgment (what actually happened commercially) stand behind a documented, inspectable basis and KB-05's requirement that error-correction paths function rather than merely exist. Full autonomous resolution of any exception population is deliberately out of scope for the initial target state: it may be introduced later only for a named, bounded population after a monitored parallel-run validation period (a minimum of two full quarters) demonstrates an acceptable error rate to the controller, and even then a permanent residual sample of that population continues to route to human review, and a hard kill-switch exists to force the entire population back to full human confirmation. The redesign explicitly displaces investigation/drafting task content from analysts to the agent; the analyst role is redefined into evidence-based confirmation, sampled release review (TGT-03) and periodic cross-exception pattern review (TGT-04), and this is named as a workforce redeployment decision requiring explicit transition planning, not an unstated reduction.
inputs: Vendor correspondence and historical pattern data
steps.name: Agent-assisted exception investigation with human-confirmed disposition
outputs: Exception resolution evidence (evidence package, agent reasoning trace, and human confirmation/override record)

steps.description: Clean and in-tolerance matches auto-release without human review, since a mechanical comparison against a stated, versioned policy involves no estimation under KB-04. Matches carrying an exception resolution or a tolerance override route, event-triggered, to an AP supervisor who sees the underlying variance detail, the resolution evidence from TGT-02, and the specific policy basis for any override -- never a summary flag alone -- preserving real (not merely titular) actor separation from the analyst who resolved the exception. Separately, a deterministic, auditable, risk-weighted scoring function (new vendor, recent master-data or ownership change, near-threshold variance) schedule-triggers a sample of the auto-released population to the same supervisor queue, sized and weighted for genuine detection probability of both engine defects and deliberate threshold-gaming, with a visible, low-friction path to escalate any systemic finding into the tolerance-policy or matching-engine change-request queue so sampling reaches root causes rather than only repeated symptoms. The interface distinguishes exception/override-triggered review from sample-triggered review so the supervisor knows what scrutiny each case requires.
inputs: Risk-weighted sample selection of auto-released matches
steps.name: Exception/override release gate with risk-weighted sampling of auto-released matches

steps.description: Every agent tool call, rules-engine classification, human confirmation or override, and sampling outcome is written as an immutable, append-only, queryable event to a single control-record store, so any match can be reconstructed end-to-end -- satisfying KB-02's requirement that the evidential trail survive the redesign. This replaces the periodic manual compilation activity, but not the review act: an AP accountant performs a genuine monthly attestation with a defined minimum scope (override volumes by approver, exception-resolution patterns by category, sampling findings and what was or wasn't escalated, cross-exception patterns pointing to upstream procurement/PO-template issues), and the attestation itself is logged as an event with its own findings and escalations, so the control-about-a-control is itself evidenced. The underlying log and the attestation extract must be accessible via a lightweight, exportable report (not only a live BI dashboard), so the checkpoint continues to function where analytics licensing or connectivity is constrained.
steps.name: Continuous control logging with reviewed monthly attestation
outputs: Match control record (immutable event log, reconstructable per match)
